2609.24814.title: Mobile Imaging Solutions for Medical Diagnosis: Trends and Applications
2609.24814.paper_summary: Advances in processing power, camera technologies, and mobile image analysis have made smartphones and other mobile devices, such as laptops, increasingly suitable for medical diagnosis and healthcare applications. Researchers have developed low-cost solutions for the early detection and monitoring of various health conditions, including eye and ENT diseases, malnutrition, heart rate variability, skin and oral conditions, and injuries, using images captured by non-medical devices such as smartphones and webcams. This survey examines existing research on mobile image-based medical diagnosis, with an emphasis on its potential to enable low-cost and accessible healthcare. We comparatively analyze state-of-the-art solutions across different healthcare application categories, examining their advantages and limitations. Based on this analysis, we identify desirable characteristics of mobile image-based diagnostic tools and highlight areas where existing approaches have made progress as well as areas requiring further research. We also discuss application-specific and common challenges and outline directions for future research. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive overview of mobile image-based healthcare solutions and their potential to support low-cost disease diagnosis and monitoring, particularly for underserved populations in remote and resource-constrained settings.
2609.24814.paper_summary_zh: 隨著處理能力、相機技術和移動影像分析的進步，智慧型手機和其他移動設備（如筆記型電腦）越來越適合用於醫療診斷和健康護理應用。研究人員已經開發出低成本的解決方案，用於早期檢測和監測各種健康狀況，包括眼科和耳鼻喉科疾病、營養不良、心率變異性、皮膚和口腔狀況以及受傷，這些解決方案利用非醫療設備（如智慧型手機和網路攝影機）捕捉的影像。本調查研究了現有的基於移動影像的醫療診斷研究，著重於其能夠實現低成本和可及性健康護理的潛力。我們對不同健康護理應用類別中的最新解決方案進行了比較分析，檢視它們的優勢和限制。基於這一分析，我們確定了基於移動影像的診斷工具的理想特徵，並突顯了現有方法所取得的進展以及需要進一步研究的領域。我們還討論了特定應用和共同挑戰，並概述了未來研究的方向。總體而言，本研究提供了基於移動影像的健康護理解決方案的全面概述，以及它們在支持低成本疾病診斷和監測方面的潛力，特別是對於在偏遠和資源有限的環境中被忽視的人群。
